title: Apache Solr: overview film
description: Search results in your design, with Desiderio. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 44 seconds: Apache Solr for TYPO3 v14. Top results while you type; One click narrows the results; The same page in dark mode. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Solr finds your content, but its default templates look like another site.
Desiderio’s templates give Solr’s results, filters and page numbers your theme.
After three letters, suggestions and top results appear, usable with the keyboard.
Active filters show as chips, and every option keeps its own count.
Switch the preset or dark mode, and search follows, with no CSS of its own.
